u0: The agent has not picked up the matching key while the door was closed, and the door has not been opened; no conditional obligation has been triggered yet. The requirement remains conditional: if the agent later picks up the matching key, it must also open the door. If neither the key is taken before the door opens nor the door is opened, this monitoring state persists.
u1: The matching key has been picked up while the door was still closed, so the hard requirement is now pending: the door must be opened. Until the door is opened, the agent remains in this state, and dropping or losing the key does not erase the obligation. Opening the door fulfills the condition and advances beyond this pending stage.
u2: The door has been opened, so the conditional requirement is satisfied: any pickup of the matching key has been followed by opening the door. No further obligation from this rule is pending, but this machine declares no completed final state, so the overall task remains in progress. Later changes to the door do not create a new obligation here.
